text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the new year arriving, I renew my 
resolve and pray to the sunrise for the 
growth of <chrname> and the development of the 
Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a coincidence.
choice_data_list: Are the two of you out for a run?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Spee-sa—Speed Symboli-san rarely has 
a day off, you see. She is keeping me 
company.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What perfect timing! Rudolf, let's share 
the news with Trainer as well!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It seems this girl scored remarkably well 
on last year's overall exams. Her teacher 
gave her a special assignment—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: P-Please, you don't need to bring that up.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Is that so? —Ah, I see. My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, Rudolf. Tell me more about 
it. Today belongs to you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Parting ways with the two, I move away 
from the beach... and on the path back to 
the academy while gazing at the river—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The New Year Live is reaching its ultimate 
climax☆ Can everyone get even more hyped 
up~?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Falco-chan is so energetic, isn't she? 
It seems she's been holding lives every 
single day since the start of the new 
year.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Her fans gathered early in the morning 
too... Everyone looks so happy...♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. After all... moments where feelings 
resonate with each other are truly 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'm going to discuss holding an 
impromptu live! I want to see my fans too!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, one last thing! Trainer-san, Happy 
New Year! See you later~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I told you I'm sick of this already~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Who cares how firm the mochi is! Just make 
it whatever! I'm not pounding mochi 
anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
B-But just a little more pounding and 
it'll be super chewy, you know? It'll 
taste way better that way, so just a bit 
more—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
—Bravo! Your form while pounding mochi was 
truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Y-You think so?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I would dearly love to taste 
it—the soft, chewy mochi enchanted by your 
magic. ...Could I possibly trouble you for 
some?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
............Well, if you want to eat it 
that badly, I suppose I could keep going 
for a bit! Just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer. No matter the era... the 
younger generations are always so very 
endearing, are they not?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
New glories shall awaken once again this 
year. For the sake of an unyielding 
future... let us dedicate our utmost 
efforts.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
—Happy New Year! I look forward to working 
with you again this year.
